diagnosis: ProcurementOrderTransitionView updates the StatusField on ProcurementOrder based on a user-supplied target_status (e.g., transitioning from 'pending_review' to 'approved' or 'disbursed'). The view queries ProcurementOrder.objects.get(pk=order_id) without checking that order.organization == request.user.organization or that the user has departmental approval authority over this specific order. An attacker can transition orders belonging to other organizations into approved status.
exploit_request:
POST /api/procurement/orders/8834/transition/ HTTP/1.1
Host: erp.supplyops.internal

{"target_status": "approved"}
